The useful signal on $CELR is not the headline move; it is whether participation confirms the next break.

The current evidence supports a SHORT scenario. The fresh 1H structure and flow proxy are pointing in the same direction.

Confirmation comes from price reaching the trigger and holding it; a break of invalidation ends the thesis.

Entry trigger: 0.003136714. TP1: 0.001339678. TP2: -0.000457358. SL / invalidation: 0.00493375.

The trigger matters more than the headline. A clean hold is confirmation; a fast wick is not.

Would you take a clean 1H break below 0.003136714, or wait for the retest?

Conditional setup only; invalidation wins.

editorial_instructions: Prefer a specific thesis over a generic price recap.
Generate multiple hooks and select the strongest evidence-supported hook.
Lead with why the reader should care, then show the evidence.
Use disagreement, questions, or implications only when supported by facts.
Make charts explain one claim instead of merely displaying candles.
If no strong evidence-backed angle exists, wait rather than post filler.
